item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Forecast: Sprinkles, then record-breaking heat returns
item.description: A few sprinkles or a light shower are possible for the first half of Tuesday with highs in the 60s. The low 80s return Wednesday with mostly sunny skies. Record-breaking heat returns on Thursday. A cold front on Friday now looks to be a dry front, but it'll drop temperatures for the weekend.

item.title: NTSB chair: LaGuardia crash investigator was stuck in TSA line for hours
item.description: The head of the National Transportation Safety Board said Monday that long lines at airport security checkpoints caused by the ongoing Department of Homeland Security (DHS) shutdown delayed investigators arriving at the scene of a deadly collision between a jet and a fire truck at LaGuardia International Airport.

item.title: Are TSA PreCheck and CLEAR affected by long security lines?
item.description: Travelers are facing hourslong security lines at some of the nation's busiest airports as a government funding standoff leaves the Transportation Security Administration short-staffed.

item.title: Delta suspends special congressional desk service amid shutdown
item.description: Delta Air Lines is suspending its dedicated flight assistance service for members of Congress as airport security lines grow longer amid the ongoing partial government shutdown, according to the Atlanta Journal-Constitution.
